description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController' in the OrangeHRM application. The class is responsible for generating and serving a sample CSV file containing employee data headers when its handle method is invoked.

classes.name: EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating and returning a CSV sample file for employee data import purposes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by preparing a CSV sample content, setting appropriate headers, and returning the response containing the CSV data.
